description: Corrected provenance copy of the HHC compound-term YouTube run. The handover document remains 20261101-youtube-hhc-cannabinoid-raw-collection.json and its bytes are unchanged; this copy records the current actor input vocabulary, a portable handover reference, and the evidence state without rewriting the original. The run is retained raw provenance and is OUTSIDE this study's liquid-only primary coverage; it is not a required companion to the HHC リキッド run and it does not complete any liquid coverage. It is not a re-staging document: the run id already exists and staging it again must fail closed.

runs.purpose: Owner-requested HHC compound-term YouTube collection, retained as provenance outside the study's liquid-only primary coverage.

collection_request.actor_input_basis: Owner correction 2026-11-01 (exact actor input vocabulary and the 0 limits) plus the original declaration, which recorded the limit 500 under the previous actor's max_videos key. The export's input column is 'HHC' for all 482 records and its type column is 'video' for all 482; neither is proof of the input values, but both are consistent with them.
collection_request.date_filter_basis: No dateFilter was supplied to the actor. 'all' is the declaration vocabulary for the unbounded request (src/collection/adapters/youtube/apify_csv.py DATE_FILTERS); the actor itself has no 'all' value.

temporal.boundary_semantics: Observed video publish-date range in the payload, normalized to a half-open UTC day interval; not the API condition and not a request window.
limitations: The request had no dateFilter and therefore no absolute publish-date window; the search was unbounded as far as the actor input states.
window.start is the earliest observed video publish date at 00:00:00Z and window.end_exclusive is one day after the latest observed publish date; both are derived from returned items only.
The actor returns a search-result sample, not a census. The payload does not establish whether further matching videos existed.
The run is not country-limited by an API geo filter. The bare compound term is not restricted to Japanese product content; that is why it is outside the liquid-only primary design.

timestamps.basis: Actor run lEChIRnduWdaIlbwM as reported in the original handover declaration; the Apify run status object itself is not in this checkout.

execution_evidence.final_run_status_note: The Apify final run status object is not available offline. Corroborate it through ISS-20261015-PRV-013 before treating the status as verified.
execution_evidence.partial_result_note: 482 records returned against the recorded maxResults 500; the payload does not establish whether further matches existed.

scope.retained_reason: Outside the liquid-only primary design; kept as raw provenance and excluded from primary coverage.
